decisions.reason: Full-page sizing applies specifically to chapter illustrations and does not change the existing paperback trim size or general interior-layout attributes.
Formatting chapter images as full-page does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or body-text formatting.
The chapter-image size decision does not alter the requirement for table-of-contents page numbers or their update timing.
The full-page chapter-image formatting decision does not affect the copyright-page publisher line or its layout.
The source concerns chapter images and does not resolve or change the uncertainty about whether the interior title page should contain an image.
Full-page chapter-image formatting has no effect on the prohibition against a literal newline artifact in the book title.
The source commitment refers to the chapter images discussed in the immediately preceding message, not to the separate paperback cover artifact or cover content.
Chapter-image sizing does not change the requested back matter or author-copy content.
Formatting chapter illustrations as full-page does not change manuscript wording, approved passages, or the copyediting goal.
